notes: This portable C++ scenario uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs. It resolves an interaction class from the adapter FOM, queries the transportation type of a separate active federate that has published that class, verifies the standard callback report and its resolvable transportation handle, then repeats the query after the requester resigns while remaining connected. The peer remains a valid active federate so the post-resignation check isolates the requester's execution-membership boundary.

api_surfaces.signature: virtual void queryInteractionTransportationType(FederateHandle const& federate, InteractionClassHandle const& interactionClass) = 0
virtual void reportInteractionTransportationType(FederateHandle const& federate, InteractionClassHandle const& interactionClass, TransportationTypeHandle const& transportationType) = 0
